rows.name:
Hadashal Palace is both the Emperor's
palace and a defensive stronghold for
Alba Margen.

rows.label: tlk45320151_01_msg0002
rows.name:
On the upper floors, you should see
several enormous gunports.

rows.label: tlk45320151_01_msg0003
rows.name:
The elevators to the left and
right will take you up there,
if you're interested.
